title: Keel Skill (keel/v1alpha1)
description: kind: Skill — spec section 14.12: operational knowledge with loading levels (compact / full) and rejected/accepted example pairs that feed the `exemplar` of blocking packets (section 10.4). `compact` is only a preview/index for discovery; `full` is the authoritative skill context delivered by default when a model loads the skill.

description.description: One-line description of what the skill does, for the exposed catalog (D-013).

match.description: Declarative routing (D-014): when this skill applies to a prompt. Optional — the compiler always derives terms from id+description; `match` augments/refines.

terms.description: Explicit alias words/phrases (weighted above derived terms) — the lever that disambiguates sibling skills, e.g. `coderabbit`.

context.description: Structured object types this skill applies to, e.g. github_pr, github_issue, linear_ticket. Highest-precision signal.

autoload.description: Opt-in push: on a high-confidence match, inject this skill's full content instead of only exposing it. Default false.

compact.description: Compact preview/index used for discovery or explicit `full:false` loads. Prefer inline YAML literal content; legacy workspace-relative `_keel.md` paths remain supported during migration.

full.description: Authoritative skill context delivered by default when the skill is loaded. Prefer inline YAML literal content; legacy workspace-relative `_keel.md` paths remain supported during migration.
